added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

durability.reason: eqdsk is installed transitively through torax, so removing the direct declaration changes no installed package and no behaviour; a committed test could only pin the text of pyproject.toml, and the declared negative control (uv lock --check failing on a lock/pyproject mismatch) is the mechanical guard the lock workflow already runs

findings.text: follow-on: the declaration is guarded by no committed test or CI step — removing eqdsk from pyproject.toml or reverting the lock line fails nothing in the suite, since eqdsk survives transitively through torax, so the only guard is the manual negative control in negative_control.log, which nothing re-runs.

follow-on: the done-when's named check uv lock --check was run in a scratch mirror under $TMPDIR, not in the reviewed worktree where it exits 2 on the absent ../imas-ink and ../nova path deps, so the recorded EXIT=0 measures an equivalent tree rather than the reviewed one; the deviation is forced by the worktree layout and is reported in the manifest.

follow-on: the fragment's gate bullet quotes the pytest command without the -k deselection that actually ran, so a reader reproducing it would collect 7 tests rather than the 5 passed / 2 deselected it reports.

item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when names uv lock --check, then pytest tests/challenge/test_loader.py, then ruff, each exit 0, plus a landing fragment; the manifest records all four (gate.log) with the lock check run in a scratch mirror because the worktree cannot resolve the path deps.

item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reads status complete, names commit 09de3a2b, records the three gate results and their logs, and states both the worktree lock-resolution gap and the two deselected corpus tests.

justifications.fit: the pyproject line follows the surrounding "name>=version" style and the fragment matches every sibling under docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/, though it quotes the gate command without the -k filter that ran.
